stack.dimension_limits: The pinned M17 geometry supplies an 11 mm frame envelope. Published iRPC design sources report four 1.4 mm HPL electrodes and two 1.4 mm gas gaps; an earlier electronics report describes a 0.6 mm readout PCB. These dimensions total 9 mm. The remaining 2 mm is an unallocated display margin, not a modeled component or production claim.
stack.schematic_rule: Place the sourced 9 mm stack at the center of the 11 mm M17 frame envelope. Leave the 1 mm margin on each side unmodeled; do not infer its construction.
